answer: Each agent must mint a hardware-bound identity and lock a bond in a shared escrow; the bond vests only after the agent completes a varied orchard of verification tasks, while a quartz-timed heartbeat proves ongoing liveness. Duplicate agents that share hardware roots, reuse credentials, or show tightly correlated timing are slashed and added to a sable registry, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs more than the rewards they can extract.
